description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientService interface, providing methods for CRUD operations and business logic related to Client entities within a Spring application.

classes.name: ClientServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing business logic for managing Client entities, including CRUD operations, associated with Spring's @Service annotation for dependency injection.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieve a Client by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Find a Client by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all Clients.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Return a fixed list of client status strings.

methods.name: saveClientWithLoggedUser
methods.description: Save a Client, associating it with the currently authenticated user and setting creation timestamp.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Save a Client with the current timestamp.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Delete a Client by its ID.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Retrieve Clients associated with a specific User.
